10.2.5 FrIfTransceiver
SWS Item
[ECUC_FrIf_05391]
Container Name
FrIfTransceiver
Parent Container
FrIfController
Description
Up to two FlexRay Transceivers may connect a Controller to a Cluster. This container
realizes a Controller-Transceiver assignment.
Configuration Parameters
SWS Item
[ECUC_FrIf_06062]
Parameter Name
FrIfClusterChannel
Parent Container
FrIfTransceiver
Description
This parameter identifies to which one of the two Channels (A, B, A and B) of the
Cluster the Transceiver is connected. FrIfClusterChannel shall map to Fr_ChannelType:
FRIF_CHANNEL_A == FR_CHANNEL_A FRIF_CHANNEL_B == FR_CHANNEL_B
FR_CHANNEL_AB shall not be used.
Multiplicity
